dedupe_keys.name: china one kilometre monthly electricity consumption

description: The China electricity downscaling research team publishes monthly electricity-consumption estimates on a one-kilometre grid. The Figshare description identifies 93 GeoTIFF maps in an Albers projection, covering April 2012 to December 2019, and a companion CSV identifying 280 cities. A public ZIP archive and the city table are free under CC BY 4.0. The estimates can distribute historical demand spatially for infrastructure-planning or hazard-exposure simulations, with map preparation in platform-qgis and aggregate comparisons in model-pypsa. A caveat is that grid values are inferred through statistical downscaling, not measured at each pixel. Administrative allocation, spatial predictors and monthly constraints influence their interpretation. Consumption totals and coordinate-reference details must be checked before overlaying network assets. No raster archive or city-table rows were downloaded.
